description: This file defines a React functional component 'BackupsDropZone' used for handling backup file uploads, decryption, and saving in a web application. It handles drag-and-drop, file selection, and interacts with various application services for decryption and file management.

classes.name: BackupsDropZone
classes.description: A React functional component for managing backup file decryption and saving via a drag-and-drop interface.

methods.name: chooseRelatedBinaryFile
methods.description: Handles the selection of a related binary data file through the application file picker.

methods.name: downloadBinaryFileAsDecrypted
methods.description: Decrypts the selected backup file and saves it to the user's local directory.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles the dropping of a backup metadata file onto the component, initiating its parsing and decryption process.
